Title: Check close barrier flow and save behavior

Step Action: Sign in as a care team member and navigate to PGI & Notes > Barriers > Open.
Step Expected: The Open Barriers list is displayed.

Step Action: Click the close barrier icon on an open barrier.
Step Expected: The Close Barrier modal opens for the selected barrier.

Step Action: Attempt to save without selecting a close reason.
Step Expected: The barrier is not closed and the required close reason is indicated.

Step Action: Select a close reason and enter the Supporting Rationale.
Step Expected: The selected close reason and Supporting Rationale are entered.

Step Action: Save the Close Barrier modal.
Step Expected: The barrier is closed and the selected reason and Supporting Rationale are saved.

Step Action: Check the Open Barriers list.
Step Expected: The closed barrier no longer appears in the Open list.

Title: Check closed and voided barrier filters and See History

Step Action: From PGI & Notes, open View Closed/Voided/Dismissed PGIs and set Status to Closed.
Step Expected: The list shows closed barriers.

Step Action: Expand a closed barrier using the + icon.
Step Expected: The expanded item shows the See History icon.

Step Action: Set Status to Voided (from Open).
Step Expected: The list shows barriers voided from Open.

Step Action: Expand a voided barrier using the + icon.
Step Expected: The expanded item shows the See History icon.

Title: Check Barrier History card placement and appearance

Step Action: In View Closed/Voided/Dismissed PGIs, set Status to Closed and click See History for a closed barrier.
Step Expected: The Barrier History modal opens with the barrier card above the search bar and history table.

Step Action: Compare the card's position and styling with the cards in the Intervention and Problem History modals.
Step Expected: The barrier card uses the same position and style as those history cards.

Step Action: Close the modal and open See History for a voided barrier.
Step Expected: The voided barrier's card appears above the search bar and history table with consistent styling.

Title: Check collapsed barrier card content and current status

Step Action: Open Barrier History for a closed barrier with a category label, priority, title, individualized description, and Target Date.
Step Expected: The card is collapsed by default and shows the correct category label, priority, title, individualized description, and Target Date: [date] | Closed.

Step Action: Open Barrier History for a barrier voided from Open with known details and Target Date.
Step Expected: The collapsed card shows the barrier details and Target Date: [date] | Voided.

Step Action: Compare the card details with the corresponding barrier in the Open Barriers list.
Step Expected: The card information matches the Open Barriers card, with status reflecting the barrier's current state.

Step Action: Inspect the card for the previous status or close/void reason.
Step Expected: The card shows neither the previous status nor the close/void reason; these details appear only in the history table.

Title: Check barrier card when Target Date is unavailable

Step Action: Open Barrier History for a closed barrier without a Target Date.
Step Expected: The card displays Target Date: Not available | Closed.

Step Action: Open Barrier History for a barrier voided from Open without a Target Date.
Step Expected: The card displays Target Date: Not available | Voided.

Title: Check barrier card expand and collapse details

Step Action: Open Barrier History and click show more.
Step Expected: The card expands, Created by, Created Date/Time, and Patient Friendly Description appear, and the link changes to show less.

Step Action: Click show less.
Step Expected: The expanded details are hidden and the link changes back to show more.

Step Action: Expand and collapse the card while observing the search bar and history table.
Step Expected: The search bar and history table remain visible and usable.

Title: Check selected barrier card and default state when reopening history

Step Action: Open a barrier's history, expand its card, and close the modal.
Step Expected: The modal closes.

Step Action: Reopen the same barrier's history.
Step Expected: The card is collapsed by default and displays the selected barrier's details.

Step Action: Close the modal and open history for a different barrier with different details.
Step Expected: The card and history show the newly selected barrier with no stale content from the previous barrier.

Title: Check closing and voiding changes in barrier history

Step Action: Open history for a barrier closed from In Progress with a known close reason and Supporting Rationale.
Step Expected: The table has Change Date, Changed By, Field, and Change columns, and records the person who closed the barrier and the date and time of closing.

Step Action: Inspect the closing entries in the history table.
Step Expected: The table records Status (In Progress → Closed), Status Reason with the selected close reason, and Supporting Rationale with the saved rationale.

Step Action: Open history for a barrier voided from Open with a known void reason and Supporting Rationale.
Step Expected: The table records the person who voided the barrier and the date and time of voiding, plus Status (In Progress → Voided), Status Reason with the void reason, and Supporting Rationale.

Title: Check barrier field changes and no edits after closing or voiding

Step Action: Use a barrier with known changes to Status, Target Date, and other fields before closing or voiding, then open its history.
Step Expected: Each pre-terminal change appears with its changed field and change, the person who made it, and the date and time.

Step Action: Inspect the Status and Target Date history entries.
Step Expected: Changes to Status and Target Date are recorded in the table like other barrier field changes.

Step Action: Inspect the history through the closing or voiding event.
Step Expected: The table includes changes from creation through the terminal event, including Status, Status Reason, and Supporting Rationale.

Step Action: Attempt to edit the closed or voided barrier.
Step Expected: The closed or voided barrier cannot be edited.

Step Action: Refresh or reopen its history after the attempted edit.
Step Expected: No changes are recorded after the closing or voiding event.

Title: Check barrier history search and column sorting

Step Action: Open Barrier History for a barrier with known history entries.
Step Expected: The table displays Change Date, Changed By, Field, and Change.

Step Action: Search for a value present in the history, then search for a value with no matching entries. Clear the search.
Step Expected: Matching entries appear for the matching search; the existing no-results behavior appears for the unmatched search; clearing the search restores all entries.

Step Action: Sort each sortable column in both supported directions.
Step Expected: The table sorts as it does in the Intervention and Problem History modals without changing row data.

Step Action: Apply a search and sort, then expand and collapse the barrier card.
Step Expected: The search text, matching results, and sort order are preserved; the search and table remain usable.

Title: Check long barrier history scrolling and Close button

Step Action: Open Barrier History for a barrier with long content and enough history entries to require scrolling.
Step Expected: The card and history remain readable and the modal scrolls when needed.

Step Action: Scroll through the history table.
Step Expected: The Close button remains accessible.

Step Action: Click Close.
Step Expected: The modal closes and returns to the underlying PGI view.

Step Action: Reopen the modal, expand the card, and scroll through the long history.
Step Expected: The Close button remains accessible and closes the expanded modal.
